cause: Inbox startup route selected ANY shared open event regardless of readAt/acknowledgedAt, and kept reevaluating initial landing on later background refresh and active-role changes. Read-click swallowed server failure. Persisted hash deliberately acts as an explicit route/deep link.
fix: Only new unread and unacknowledged/unresolved/unarchived notices may trigger one initial landing. Returning to Inicio follows successful readback of auto-landed acknowledge/resolve when none unseen remain. Preserves explicit deep links and later notifications as badge without interrupting navigation. Offers Ir a Inicio.
backend: Existing persisted user inboxState read/ack and shared inboxTasks resolve; no backend data change.
userUXNotes: Opening a request marks READ, not RESOLVED.
Recognize is personal and does not close work for the team.
Resolve for all changes shared inbox state, not underlying workflow/business status.
The red Acción requerida #2 card represents the collaboration direction independently of the unread badge; a separate workflow response is required.
Opening an explicit URL ending /#/ops navigates to Ops by design.
